name: SSHI_LC_Filter
rationale: The previous best design 'SSHI_FullBridge' failed only on S3 ripple (51.4 mV vs 50 mV). S3 has a very light load, meaning the ripple is dominated by the charge packets delivered by the SSHI inversion. To reduce this without increasing the output capacitor (which would increase cold-start time too much for S4), I am introducing an LC filter. By inserting an inductor between the bridge output node (n_bridge) and the storage capacitor node (out), the high-frequency current spikes from the rectifier are smoothed, significantly reducing the peak-to-peak ripple on the output.
